study.question: Does explicit recency of behavior on nonmatching categories/brands add useful evidence beyond the incumbent target-match recency and general activity recency, or is any improvement explained by activity timing and representation capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observation: baseline static/pooled/target-aware AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. r0010-match_latest has AUC 0.6187731489, Logloss 0.1959282131, versus activity_latest 0.6187361779/0.1959483454, match_mean 0.6182709084/0.1961312899 and activity_mean 0.6187015166/0.1959494716. Latest-minus-mean is 0.0005022405 for match but 0.0000346613 for activity (interaction 0.0004675792); match-minus-activity for latest is only 0.0000369710. These are single-seed validation-selected exploratory observations, not confirmed target specificity. The incumbent scalar branch summarizes matching events and joint field availability, but does not explicitly isolate latest nonmatching events. Candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics show match/activity latest mean absolute feature distance 0.045939 and match-present field/action fraction 0.169922; these are restricted diagnostics, not population estimates. Mechanism hypothesis: a complement-event recency channel gives the shallow classifier a useful target-relative context alongside target-match recency. Nonmatching behavior may reflect multiple concurrent interests rather than negative preference; coefficient sign is unconstrained and no psychological claim is made.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:din; arXiv 1706.06978v4 section 4.3, archived primary lines 250-283; content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2
nearest_work.difference: DIN uses learned target-conditioned weighted sum pooling and explicitly abandons softmax normalization. Our local ancestor uses normalized shared category/brand attention, blind static context, and engineered scalar evidence. This proposal retains that adaptation and adds eight deterministic per-field/action nonmatching-event decay summaries. Learned soft relevance already can represent nonmatching evidence, so the proposed difference is explicit statistic exposure, not previously unavailable information or a verified new method. Source also describes concurrent noisy interests; nonmatching does not imply disinterest.

Author README verifies category/brand/action availability and lack of item IDs. We use only supplied field IDs, action and causal ages; no item matching or DMR reproduction. Publisher full text is unavailable, so detailed DMR novelty/difference is unresolved.

Exact source hash matches candidate.py and authorized history_r0010_match_latest.py. Inherits the complete 32-feature incumbent and adds a separate eight-feature complement/activity factorial branch. Existing r0010 variants replaced the original eight summaries and are not matched controls for the new joint representation.

inherited_components: Frozen host data identity bd5ca20f6c2ca3e084ad11e12bf6200adbd293e060e1efb96dcb070f64ff81fa; first-six-day exposures, natural prevalence, three epochs, batch 4096, history limit 128, seed 42, unweighted scorer and fixed validation sample identity.
All field embeddings (dimension 16), action/recency embeddings, blind static-context query with gain 0.5, aligned shared field retrieval, normalized masking and hidden widths [128,64].

All 24 ancestral count/one-day aligned mass/pair-support features plus eight target-matching latest decay features, in their original order. Construct incumbent first, then append zero input columns without new random draws. Same Adam/lr 0.001 and host loss; no training_loss or optimizer override.

Audited failures/nulls remain evidence: action retrieval r0003-action_attention 0.6179337371 lost to parent support_pair 0.6184566652; availability normalization r0006-available_active 0.6182828780, direct aligned product r0007-aligned_product 0.6179083851, magnitude readout r0008-target_raw 0.6184930072 and learned horizon r0009-horizon_aligned 0.6184993393 all lost to query_blind 0.6186034709. Exact joint pairing r0002-joint_pair 0.6183522161 did not beat support_pair. Do not revive these mechanisms on external authority. No execution failures are present in supplied trajectory status; previous_runtime_error is null.
study.proposed_difference: For each field f in {category,brand} and action a, form V={masked valid events of action a with positive field ID and positive target field ID}; N={e in V: field(e)!=target(f)}. d(e)=exp(-ln(2)*age(e)/86400). Append exactly eight summaries: max_N d for candidate; max_V d for activity/latest control; mean_N d for nonmatch/mean control; mean_V d for activity/mean control. Every cell is gated by |N|>0; absent/unknown target, absent nonmatch, missing field and empty history give exact zero. Use zero sentinel for maxima and count.clamp_min(1) for means. No event sorting, alternate users, new history, labels or external reads. All four summaries are computed for every model. The same eight input coordinates and 1024 new dense weights are initialized to zero after incumbent construction. Predicted parameter count 17,135,395 (17,078,688 embedding; 56,707 dense), subject to host measurement. The binding contrast changes age population conditional on identical nonmatch-presence gate; it does not isolate the value of that gate. Activity controls still know nonmatch existence. New scalar summaries change inductive bias, not the authorized information set. Nearest-work search returned only DIN/DMR; TIN cited in inherited docstring was not registered (paper:tin resolution failed), so no verified TIN comparison or novelty claim is made.
predictions: Primary descriptive contrasts at matched seed/data passes: nonmatch_latest AUC exceeds parent r0010-match_latest and activity_latest; secondary Logloss should not worsen. Binding effect is nonmatch_latest minus activity_latest; reduction effect is nonmatch_latest minus nonmatch_mean. Compute interaction as [nonmatch_latest-activity_latest]-[nonmatch_mean-activity_mean]. Report all four values without treating a winning cell as mechanism proof.
If complement extremes matter, latest-versus-mean advantage should be greater for nonmatching than activity summaries. This is an exploratory interaction test, with no assumed sign for click logits.

Mechanism diagnostics must show nonzero complement/activity feature differences and nonzero trained dependence on the new coordinates; all new features must be finite in [0,1], zero for empty histories/missing target/no nonmatching event. Fixed-checkpoint counterfactual logit changes show activation only.

Report frozen host slices with their sample/positive/negative counts, especially category_match_present (2516922/129821/2387101), category_match_absent (717129/29616/687513), history_1_16 (41805/1444/40361) and empty_history (8272/310/7962). Absent-category matches make nonmatch/activity category summaries algebraically identical, so improvements there cannot establish category complement selection; brand and global training can still differ. Do not infer slice significance from one seed.

Analytic witness checked locally: identical target count=1, target decay sum/latest=0.9, valid activity count=3 and sum=1.9, activity latest=0.9, nonmatch count=2 and mean=0.5 can coexist with nonmatch latest=0.8 versus 0.6. Thus the new maximum is not determined by those inherited scalar summaries. The learned history pool already sees event ages/IDs and may distinguish these cases; this is a scalar-representation distinction, not proof of information loss in the full model.
falsifiers: Nonmatch_latest fails to beat incumbent and activity_latest under the same full protocol; do not claim supported predictive or target-specific improvement. A benefit shared equally by activity controls suggests representation/activity context rather than complement timing.

If nonmatch_mean is equal or better, maximum specificity is unsupported even if complement selection helps. If the two binding effects have inconsistent signs, report interaction rather than selecting a convenient main effect.

No meaningful nonmatch/activity feature separation, or negligible checkpoint dependence, weakens the proposed implementation mechanism. Empty/unknown-target/nonmatch-absent nonzero features or invalid finite logits invalidate the implementation rather than refuting the hypothesis.

A later paired-seed reversal or user-cluster interval spanning zero removes repeated support. Local diagnostics on first 512, coarsened/hashed field inequality, history truncation and validation search can explain a small apparent gain.
alternative_explanations: Shared added capacity, easier optimization of redundant nonlinear features, or generic activity/field-availability context may explain parent-relative gains. Four equal-capacity cells isolate event binding/reduction but the parent has 1024 fewer weights; no pure capacity attribution to parent is claimed.

Target-field inequality is coarse and may include substitutable products, concurrent interests or hash collisions. No item identity, dwell time or negative preference labels are available. Do not call these negative behaviors or infer causal suppression.

Conditional gates and sparse cart/fav/buy support can dominate signal; all cells share the nonmatch gate, but reductions differ in variance/support dependence. Field identity/action composition and recency distributions remain intertwined.

All earlier comparisons and this first screen use one seed and the same validation population after many adaptive rounds. No confidence/significance or independent mechanism replication claim; users have repeated impressions. Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented and 128-event truncation limits generality.
